Product Profile
DRR Dhan 42 is an early-maturing, medium height, long slender, high yielding and widely adaptable variety grown under irrigated lowland and upland conditions. It exhibits drought tolerance and performs well in water-scarce environments. Yield advantage is approximately 1.0 mt/ha over other varieties of similar maturity under drought stress conditions. Developed collaboratively by IIRR & IRRI and released in 2016, it is specifically recommended for cultivation in Southern and Central India. Additionally, DRR Dhan 42 showcases tolerance to lodging and grain shattering while delivering excellent grain and eating quality.

Key Strengths
- High yield
- Drought tolerant
- Long slender grain
- Early maturity; Non-lodging; non-shattering
- Excellent eating quality
- Resistant to leaf blast
